name: IJN Aoba
shortDescription: Twin-turreted heavy cruiser with hard-hitting 203mm guns and torpedoes, trading rate of fire and protection for range and per-hit punch.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 60s cooldown, unlimited charges. Same stock cycle as Furutaka's or Omaha's, nothing unique to this hull.

consumables.name: Sonar
consumables.flavor: 3.9 km ship detection, 2.8 km torpedo detection, 92s duration, 180s cooldown, 2 charges. One of two options in the same utility slot, marginally longer range and duration than Furutaka's near-identical version.

consumables.name: Defensive AA Fire
consumables.flavor: +200% AA damage, 40s duration, 150s cooldown, 2 charges. The other option in that same slot, worth taking over Sonar when the enemy team is carrier-heavy since the stock AA doesn't hold up alone.

consumables.name: Catapult Fighter
consumables.flavor: 100s uptime, 80s cooldown, 3 charges. Same numbers as Furutaka's, and the only anti-air answer in the kit if Sonar is picked instead.

turrets.note: Sole aft turret, no amidships mounts like Furutaka's pyramid layout.

torpedoMounts.label: Port
torpedoMounts.note: Fixed to this broadside only, the same fixed-mount layout as Furutaka rather than a centerline swing.

strengths: 14.4 km firing range upgraded beats Leander's 12.9 km and Nürnberg's 13.4 km, and nearly matches Molotov's 14.8 km, letting her poke from beyond most tier V cruiser gun range
16,267 torpedo damage is the hardest-hitting fish among researched tier V cruiser peers, ahead of Leander's 15,733, Molotov's 14,400, and Nürnberg's 13,700
35 kt top speed outruns Leander's and Nürnberg's 32 kt, trailing only Molotov's 36 kt
4,700 AP and 3,300 HE per 203mm shell hits harder per shot than the smaller-caliber guns most tier V cruiser peers carry, backed by the official Superior HE Damage trait
17% HE fire chance per shell is backed by the official Pyromania trait
weaknesses: 10.5s reload across only six guns gives below-average HE and AP DPM against the researched tier V cruiser peer group
Official Sluggish Aim trait means turret traverse lags behind, a real problem when a target crosses her firing arc
102s torpedo reload is far slower than Leander's 96s, Molotov's 70s, or Nürnberg's 68s, so a dodged salvo costs a long wait for the next one
Thin protection: 6mm minimum armor and only 4% torpedo damage reduction, both behind Trento's 13mm minimum and 10% reduction
83 DPS AA looks fine on paper but every mount is short-ranged (1.2-4.5 km), so planes are past the outer layers before taking real damage
tips: Fight at range where the 14.4 km reach and hard-hitting 203mm shells pay off, closing the distance just exposes the slow reload and thin armor to return fire.
Pick your broadside before committing to a torpedo run, the mounts are welded one per side with no centerline swing.
Lead your aim early against a turning target, the official Sluggish Aim traverse won't catch up mid-fight.
Swap Sonar for Defensive AA Fire when carriers are in the match, the stock AA doesn't hold up on its own.

threats.reason: Every AA mount is short-ranged, so planes close to effective range before the DPS matters.

threats.threat: Anything that closes the range fast
threats.reason: Sluggish turret traverse and a slow main battery reload both punish her hardest once a fight goes close-range.
A 102s cycle means a missed or dodged salvo leaves her without an answer for a long stretch.

summary: Twin-turreted heavy cruiser, three 203mm turrets in a straightforward two-forward-one-aft layout, no amidships mounts.
Wins by out-ranging and out-hitting rather than out-firing, the reload is slow but every shell and torpedo lands hard.
Torpedo tubes are fixed one per broadside, committing to a side before the fish are in the water.
AA looks respectable on a stat sheet but every mount is short-ranged, so she leans on Defensive AA Fire more than most tier V cruisers.
playstyle.detail: Aoba refines Furutaka's pyramid-turret idea into something simpler: three twin 203mm turrets, two forward and one aft, with no broadside-only amidships mounts to work around. What she loses in gun count she gets back in range and payload, 14.4 km reach and 4,700 AP per shell make her a real threat to anyone who lets her sit at distance, and her 16,267-damage torpedoes hit harder than any tier V cruiser peer researched so far. The tradeoffs are the same family of problems Furutaka has: a slow reload, official Sluggish Aim traverse, and thin protection that doesn't forgive getting caught up close. Play her like an artillery piece, not a brawler, pick the range, keep the guns firing, and save the torpedoes for a target that's already committed.

goalTags.note: 16,267 damage per salvo is the highest among researched tier V cruiser peers (Leander 15,733, Molotov 14,400, Nürnberg 13,700), though the fixed port/starboard mounts and 102s reload limit how often it's usable.
